newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end up on Dow, rupiah.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end up on Dow, rupiah.

text.p: The Jakarta stocks ended up on Wednesday as sentiment improved due to a less volatile rupiah and a strong rise on Wall Street on Tuesday, brokers said.

The Jakarta composite index ended up 6.75 points, or 0.95 percent, at an intra-day high of 718.19 points after touching a low of 711.77 points. Advancers led decliners by 68 to 51 with 72 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 636 billion rupiah.
"The relatively stable rupiah today coupled with a jump on Wall Street on Tuesday boosted sentiment and prompted bargain hunting in some liquid blue chips," one broker said.
Spot rupiah was traded at 2,583 at 0935 GMT from an opening of 2,570/80 on Wednesday.
The rupiah recorded its largest-ever single-day loss on Monday, plunging about 140 points to a historic low against the dollar in a series of attacks on exotic currencies.

Semen Gresik, Indosat, Telkom and Gudang Garam were among the gainers following the bargain-hunting, brokers said. Alumunium manufacturer Indal topped the active list, with some 16 million shares traded after news reports that the firm planned to form a joint venture with a Japanese firm.
Indal fell 425 rupiah to 1,825 rupiah on profit-taking. It had made strong gains since last week on speculation of the joint venture, brokers said, adding the stock was already overvalued.
Indal touched a year low of 825 rupiah in early April.
Tin miner Timah ended 50 rupiah higher at 3,225 rupiah, after rising 100 rupiah, despite a sharp fall in tin prices in the international market.

Tin prices fell to a fresh two-and-half year low on Tuesday on the London Metal Exchange as Southeast Asian tin producers boosted their sales to take advantage of their currencies' recent falls against the dollar.

Pharmaceutical firm Darya Varia was among those on the active list, with some 7.8 million shares traded after news reports that it expected to post a poor net profit in the first half of this year. Darya ended 150 rupiah lower at 2,025 rupiah.
